what: Short film for sharing (2 min 15 s): clearance, sound levels and the exported video. Values are for the fourth revision of 9 October 2026 unless a block says otherwise.
viewer: http://127.0.0.1:8765/OPEN_CHURCH.html (scratch origin, recommended design, 354 items of which 15 hidden)

clearance.method: CHURCH_CINEMA.audit({ film: 'short', step: 0.1, reach: 1.5 }); wiring-only scenes are checked against the building as if it were shown

figuresShown.source: read from the open model when the film starts (CHURCH_SIMULATOR.powerSummary(), electrical.routes, visible items by catalogue category)
figuresShown.limits: Simulator values of a design-development model. Route length is the modelled route, not installed cable length. Connected rating is the sum of ratings, not operating consumption (5.6 kW in the scene that was open).

musicOutput.what: Sound of the exported file by section (ffmpeg volumedetect: mean and maximum in dB below full scale). Digital levels, not acoustic levels.

sections.content: last bell strokes over the organ's soft entry and growth
wiring scenes to the close, full organ

musicOutput.firstRevision: Per-scene levels of the first score (bells returning at the close) were measured in the viewer and are in the Git history of this file.

recordingInViewer.what: Save as video, real time, in the Claude desktop browser pane (Chrome 152) on an Apple-silicon Mac
recordingInViewer.result: MP4, H.264 + AAC, 1920 × 1080, 121.0 s, 47 MB; 956 pictures in 120 s (about 8 a second, 4 to 15 by scene)
recordingInViewer.judgement: Works; too jerky to post from this computer

sharedFile.path: exports/sharing/thach-bi-short-film-2026-10-09.mp4 (not in the repository; replaces the first export of the same name)
sharedFile.method: scripts/film_export: 4050 pictures drawn one at a time (466 s), the first 300 drawn again after the opening card's shading was lightened; sound from one complete real-time recording (135.4 s) with a 0.06 s lead removed; joined by ffmpeg

ffprobe.video: h264 high, 1920 × 1080, yuv420p limited range BT.709, 30 frames/s, 4050 frames, 9.6 Mbit/s

sharedFile.viewed: Fifteen pictures across the film, and the first frame at full size: the lit church with the title, not black
sharedFile.incidents: Two export passes were spoiled by clicks in the page (a sound recording cut at 56 s; a frame pass stopped at frame 126) and were repeated. driver.js now refuses a short sound recording and recovers from an interrupted frame pass.
